commands.nativeVerifiedController: node --test --test-name-pattern="native production Worker|native user change after READY" tests/phi-publication.test.mjs

limitations: Legacy NTFS TxF/KTM dependency; Microsoft discourages new use, future availability is not guaranteed. Unsupported runtime/volume/API fails closed, never ordinary write/copy/path-overwrite fallback.
Forced publisher death at adjacent commit checkpoints is proved, not instruction-exact termination within CommitTransaction or hardware/power-loss durability.
Only one existing-file MODIFY is integrated with explicit trusted-controller approval; ordinary Windows autonomous workflow remains blocked.

Earlier changed-base admission between controller readback and native PREPARED can fail generically before a journal exists. Source-inspected limitation; final locked conflict and ordinary post-READY controller conflict are separately runtime proven.

Restart recovery observes old/new/conflict and updates journal metadata only. Original live ACL/creation-time proof and verified-controller draft are not reconstructed, so new content normally retains RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
Restart fixtures supply a trusted root and transaction locator. Automatic production project discovery is not implemented.
Terminal production journal records are retained with a hard serialized 64-record ceiling. Reclamation/retention policy is not implemented; admission fails closed at capacity.
Safe DELETE/RENAME/multifile publication and partial multi-file recovery are not implemented; no all-files atomicity claim.
Clones certify source-only foundation, not full product reconstruction; Doctor FAIL/fullEngine BLOCKED_NOT_INSTALLED are intentional. Linux native process census is unavailable/null, not zero.
Native cleanup certifies owned scopes/processes and temp objects, not a global runner process census. Same-user trusted controller/source/helper cache remains TCB.
E1/E2/E3, full Doctor, native/cross-platform backup-restore and complete disaster recovery certification remain outstanding.
The pre-existing protected user edit remains dirty and outside task commits.
nextAction: Reproduce the earlier native-admission classification boundary deterministically before a targeted correction; then safe DELETE/RENAME and per-operation multi-file recovery, original metadata/controller restart continuity, trusted discovery/retention. Keep D IN_PROGRESS and Windows autonomy BLOCKED until all D and E1/E2/E3 acceptance conditions.
